students_archive_state.name: students_archive_state
students_archive_state.value: ("students"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "students"."archive_reason" IS NULL) OR ("students"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL AND "students"."archive_reason" IS NOT NULL)

enrollments_trial_dates.name: enrollments_trial_dates
enrollments_trial_dates.value: "enrollments"."trial_expires_at" IS NULL OR ("enrollments"."trial_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "enrollments"."trial_expires_at" > "enrollments"."trial_started_at")

learning_resources_one_origin.name: learning_resources_one_origin
learning_resources_one_origin.value: ("learning_resources"."object_path" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("learning_resources"."object_path")) > 0 AND "learning_resources"."bucket" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("learning_resources"."bucket")) > 0 AND "learning_resources"."external_url" IS NULL) OR ("learning_resources"."object_path" IS NULL AND "learning_resources"."bucket" IS NULL AND "learning_resources"."external_url" IS NOT NULL)

lessons_trial_order_range.name: lessons_trial_order_range
lessons_trial_order_range.value: "lessons"."trial_order" IS NULL OR ("lessons"."phase" = 'foundation' AND "lessons"."trial_order" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

study_plan_lessons_trial_order_range.name: study_plan_lessons_trial_order_range
study_plan_lessons_trial_order_range.value: "study_plan_lessons"."trial_order" IS NULL OR ("study_plan_lessons"."phase" = 'foundation' AND "study_plan_lessons"."trial_order" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)

feedback_scores_range.name: feedback_scores_range
feedback_scores_range.value:
("feedback"."curriculum_score" IS NULL OR "feedback"."curriculum_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
    AND ("feedback"."teaching_score" IS NULL OR "feedback"."teaching_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
    AND ("feedback"."assistant_score" IS NULL OR "feedback"."assistant_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
    AND ("feedback"."addin_score" IS NULL OR "feedback"."addin_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
